title: MessageRequestedPayload
description: Payload of the MessageRequested event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2853 (T9). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

recipients.description: Recipient addresses (e-mail addresses or mobile numbers, per channel).

linkReference.description: A link reference to include, absent when this message carries a sealed passcode instead.

sealedPasscode.description: A sealed passcode to include (FR-AG.70, INV-REQ-2762), absent when this message carries a link reference instead. Form: v1.<keyId>.<ciphertext>. The passcode is sealed with RSAES-OAEP (RFC 8017) using SHA-256 and MGF1-SHA-256 under the RSA public delivery key of notification-svc, which is at least 3072 bits. The OAEP label is the UTF-8 bytes of the one recipient address of the message. v1 is the form version. The key id is the first 8 bytes of the SHA-256 of the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo of that key, as 16 lower-case hex digits. The ciphertext is base64url without padding (512 characters for a 3072-bit key, 683 for 4096). A message carries exactly one recipient when it carries sealedPasscode.
